description: All-in-one installer for Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable runtimes for x86 and x64, including legacy runtimes and current 2022/2026 packages.
post_install: if (-not (Test-Path "$dir\Installer.cmd")) { throw 'Installer.cmd was not found at the archive root; installation was stopped.' }
if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand -FilePath "$dir\Installer.cmd" -ArgumentList '/quiet' -RunAs)) { throw 'VisualCppRedist AIO x86/x64 installation failed.' }
notes: This manifest installs the x86 and x64 Visual C++ runtimes system-wide. Scoop requests administrator approval when it runs the upstream Installer.cmd in quiet mode.
The upstream installer checks for and removes existing non-compliant Visual C++ runtimes before installing its packages. Review the vendor documentation before installing.

Scoop uninstall does not remove the system runtimes. The upstream Uninstaller.cmd removes all detected Visual C++ runtimes (except UCRT), including runtimes not installed by this manifest; it is intentionally not run automatically.
